jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
The Service Management Product Manager is responsible for the design, governance, and continual improvement of the relevant processes that include but not limited to Change, Request, Knowledge as products and their integrations within the ServiceNow platform. This role focuses on facilitating improvements, deploying the process and product capabilities within ServiceNow, and refining requirements to align with business objectives and platform capabilities. The Product Manager balances stakeholder priorities, data-driven insights, and ServiceNow functionality to deliver scalable, efficient, and customer-focused process outcomes. This position collaborates with business and technical teams across Data Center Operations, Network Operations, and the Digital Innovation Office to drive process maturity and enhance Equinix’s global Service Management capability and customer experience.

Responsibilities
- Own the relevant processes as products within the ServiceNow platform, ensuring alignment with ITIL best practices, enterprise standards, and ServiceNow governance
- Ensure the timely delivery of the product roadmap while serving as the subject matter expert (SME) on Service Management capabilities and roadmap in ServiceNow and other supporting technologies
- Drive process and platform improvements through analysis of operational data, stakeholder feedback, and emerging business needs
- Ensure business and operational requirements are prioritized and actionable user stories and technical specifications for ServiceNow configuration and automation
- Document and maintain process frameworks, including workflows, directives, and governance standards that define how relevant processes operate within Equinix
- Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to balance stakeholder priorities and ensure consistency between process intent and system implementation
- Establish and monitor KPIs and performance metrics, using data insights to guide continuous improvement and enhance process efficiency
- Perform gap and trend analyses, using ITIL, Lean, and Agile principles to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, or improved customer experience
- Champion process adoption and change enablement, developing and maintaining communication, training, and awareness materials
- Manage and prioritize the ServiceNow product backlog for Incident and Problem Management, coordinating deployments and enhancements through Agile delivery cycles
- Serve as a bridge between operations, technical teams, ensuring technical feasibility, platform sustainability, and alignment with Equinix’s digital strategy
- Promote data quality and root cause discipline, leveraging ServiceNow reporting and analytics to drive actionable insights and preventive improvements

Qualifications
- Demonstrated experience in Service Management within large, complex organizations (preferably in a service provider or global operations context)
- Proven ability to manage Service Management processes as products, with experience defining requirements, influencing design decisions, and managing stakeholder expectations
- Strong background in ServiceNow enablement and Service Management process implementation, including workflow configuration, automation, and reporting
- Experience in continuous improvement frameworks (Lean, Agile, or ITIL CSI) to evolve process maturity
- Required: ITIL Certification
- Nice to Have: Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or ServiceNow System Administrator Certification
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify improvement opportunities and drive them to completion
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to influence across business and technical audiences
- Adept at translating complex requirements into simple, actionable steps and fostering alignment across diverse teams
- Proven ability to work independently and manage ambiguity while balancing multiple priorities
- Strategic thinker who is detail-oriented and committed to quality, governance, and scalability

Job Summary

The Product Manager will partner with the Tax business and technology teams to define, develop, and manage the lifecycle of Tax Technology products and solutions from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

The role will translate Tax business needs and pain points into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and prioritized product capabilities , working closely with engineering, data, technology, and global Tax stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines strong Tax domain expertise, product management capability, technology understanding, and stakeholder management skills , with the ability to operate across business and technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Roadmap

- Partner with Tax stakeholders to understand business priorities, processes, pain points, and technology opportunities.

- Define and prioritize the Tax Technology product roadmap aligned with business and IT strategy.

- Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve Tax processes through technology and data products.

- Balance business value, technical feasibility, risk, scalability, and delivery priorities.

Product Discovery & Requirements

- Translate Tax business requirements into product capabilities, user stories, and prioritized backlog items .

- Understand end-to-end Tax processes and data flows across Oracle Financials, Oracle TRCS, transfer pricing and related systems.

- Partner with Tax users to identify opportunities for automation, analytics, reconciliation, and improved decision-making.

- Evaluate business needs and define solutions that can scale across global Tax teams.

Product Development & Delivery

- Own product development from discovery and requirements through delivery, UAT, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement .

- Partner with engineering, data, and technology teams to define product requirements and delivery priorities.

- Lead backlog refinement, prioritization, dependency management, and release planning.

- Define acceptance criteria, test cases, and UAT requirements to ensure solutions meet business outcomes.

- Monitor product adoption, quality, performance, and user feedback and drive continuous improvements.

Business Value & Stakeholder Management

- Build business cases and articulate the value, ROI, and business impact of product investments.

- Define success metrics such as adoption, automation, efficiency, reporting cycle time, data quality, and user experience.

- Build strong relationships with global Tax stakeholders and manage expectations across business and technology teams.

- Communicate product strategy, roadmap, priorities, risks, and progress to senior stakeholders.

Market & Product Innovation

- Stay current on emerging Tax Technology, AI, automation, analytics

- Evaluate industry solutions and identify opportunities to improve the Tax technology ecosystem.

- Recommend product enhancements and new capabilities based on business needs and market trends.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Systems, Technology Consulting, or Functional Consulting.

- Strong experience working with Tax Technology / Direct Tax environments.

- Experience with Oracle TRCS or similar Tax Technology solutions preferred.

- Experience with Oracle Cloud Financials is an advantage.

- Understanding of corporate income tax, tax provision, transfer pricing, and tax data processes .

- Experience translating business needs into product requirements, user stories, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs .

- Experience managing products or technology solutions through discovery, development, UAT, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement .

- Strong understanding of data, analytics, system integrations, and enterprise technology .

- Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across Business, IT, Engineering, and Data.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to simplify complex business and technology problems and drive decisions.

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field; CA/CPA or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.

jobs.location: Remote Location - United States of America
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
Equinix Fabric is the world's leading Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) interconnection platform, operating across 65+ global metros and connecting enterprises, hyperscalers, and network service providers through carrier-class ethernet. The core ethernet layer - EPL, EVPL, and virtual connections - is the revenue engine at the heart of Fabric.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own this core ethernet services portfolio, spanning Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG management, service tokens, and Equinix Metro Connect (Fabric Metro Connect). This leader will shape how customers consume physical and virtual Layer 2 connectivity through a simpler, more unified portfolio to improve customer experience and strengthen Fabric's position as the default interconnection platform for cloud, AI, and enterprise networking.

This is a senior individual contributor role with P&L accountability, direct customer engagement, and a direct line to the product leadership team. You will define the roadmap, make the business case for investment, influence cross-functional execution, and help shape the next generation of Equinix's flagship Ethernet services.

Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
- Define the 3-year vision and quarterly roadmap for Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG architectures, service tokens, and Equinix Fabric Metro Connect

- Lead the strategic convergence of Fabric virtual connections and packet-based Metro Connect, simplifying customer choice while increasing attach, adoption, and portfolio value. Drive the ethernet services product toward higher speeds (400G+), broader metro availability, and richer service types (E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree, multipoint)

- Shape the MACsec, QoS, and resiliency roadmap in partnership with engineering and network architecture

P&L & Business Case Ownership
- Own the Fabric ethernet and Fabric Metro Connect P&L - revenue, attach rate, margin, and competitive pricing

- 7+ years of product mgmt experience, including meaningful ownership of a cloud infrastructure, networking, digital platform, or carrier connectvity products.Build and defend investment cases for major roadmap bets, including capacity expansion, new metro launches, and service type additions

- Partner with Finance and Sales to model WTP (willingness to pay), segment economics, and pricing architecture

- Track and report on product KPIs: port utilization, virtual connection growth, average bandwidth per connection, and customer retention

Technical Product Leadership
- Author precise, engineering-ready PRDs for ethernet service capabilities - VLAN handling, L2CP behavior, redundancy plane design, LAG provisioning, bandwidth tiers

- Be the internal authority on carrier ethernet standards (MEF E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree; 802.1Q, 802.1ad QinQ, MACsec, LACP)

- Work closely with network architecture on PE node topology, port provisioning, and the physical-to-virtual service binding model

- Engage deeply with the API-first vision - define the OpenAPI surface for ethernet services consumed by enterprise and cloud customers programmatically

Customer & Market Engagement
- Conduct structured discovery with enterprise network architects, cloud on-ramp teams, and carrier customers

- Own the competitive lens on carrier ethernet peers and adjacent NaaS providers

- Partner with Sales Engineering and Solutions Architecture on strategic deals requiring custom ethernet service design

- Represent the ethernet portfolio at customer advisory boards, industry forums (MEF, PTC), and external events

Qualifications
Required
- 7+ years of product mgmt experience, including meaningful ownership of a cloud infrastructure, networking, digital platform, or carrier connectvity products.

- Deep working knowledge of carrier ethernet: EPL, EVPL, E-LAN, 802.1Q/QinQ, MEF standards, Layer 2 forwarding, VLAN architectures

- Hands-on familiarity with enterprise and cloud WAN architecture - DCI, SD-WAN overlays, BGP, cloud on-ramp connectivity

- Track record of owning a P&L or product line financials - pricing, margin analysis, investment modeling

- Experience writing engineering-grade product specs that go directly into development sprints without translation overhead

- Ability to operate at the intersection of deep technical detail and C-suite business narrative - comfortably shifting registers

Strongly Preferred
- Experience at a NaaS provider, cloud provider, IXP, or carrier with direct data center or colocation interconnect products

- Familiarity with Equinix Fabric, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect product mechanics

- Exposure to MEF 3.0 certification frameworks and carrier Ethernet OAM (802.3ah, Y.1731)

- Experience with API product design - REST/OpenAPI - for network provisioning platforms

- Prior experience in a global product role spanning AMER, EMEA, and APAC markets

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Role Summary / Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, the Vice President, Product Architecture & Security Platform serves as a critical catalyst for technology transformation, platform modernization, and strategic differentiation.

The VP is a key member of the Global Product senior leadership team responsible for defining and driving the architecture, security, and advanced software platform strategy that enables the company's next generation of digital products and services.

The VP will oversee three strategic areas:
- architectural leadership and incubation of Network and Security Platform capabilities
- creation and scaling of an AI-native Product Security and Application Security engineering organization
- development of Layer 7 networking applications and agentic AI capabilities that create new customer-facing software and platform opportunities.

Combining deep technical expertise with strong business and organizational leadership, this executive will establish architecture standards, build critical security talent and capabilities, and partner across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Information Security teams to accelerate innovation, strengthen the company's security posture, and unlock higher-value software growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities and accountabilities

AI software incubation for Security Applications
- Lead incubation of AI-powered security applications and services across L7 and application security domains.
- Build agile engineering capabilities that rapidly assess, prototype, and scale emerging AI market opportunities.
- Drive innovation in intelligent traffic management, endpoint routing, and secure application connectivity.
- Develop revenue-generating adjacencies with Fabric and security platform offerings.
- Identify and accelerate new AI-driven product opportunities that strengthen Equinix's competitive differentiation.

Sovereign security platforms

- Own the strategy and roadmap for sovereign security platforms supporting trusted AI, data sovereignty, and regulated workloads.
- Build security-attested automation, certification, and compliance capabilities that enable enterprise AI training, fine-tuning, and inference deployments.
- Drive industry partnerships and standards participation to position Equinix as a leader in trusted AI and sovereign infrastructure ecosystems.
- Identify and scale new market opportunities in secure AI, confidential computing, and sovereign cloud services.

Architecture leader for Global Products

- Establish and govern architecture standards, frameworks, and engineering practices across product areas.
- Drive engineering maturity through capability assessments, coaching, and continuous improvement.
- Lead adoption of cloud-native, agile, DevSecOps, and quality engineering practices while ensuring security and compliance.  Define long-term technology strategy and platform roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
- Govern architectural risk, technical debt, and platform sustainability across the portfolio.

Engineering performance, governance and continuous improvement

- Drive engineering performance through measurable outcomes, operational metrics, and delivery excellence.
- Establish governance frameworks for technology investments, risk mitigation, and architectural compliance.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase engineering productivity, quality, reliability, and efficiency.
- Develop data-driven insights and accountability mechanisms to optimize organizational performance and execution.
- Align engineering operations and investments with business strategy, customer needs, and growth objectives

Programmable Interfaces (API) roadmap

- Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for APIs related to programmable infrastructure services.
- Establish API governance, security, and lifecycle standards across the portfolio.
- Enable customer automation and self-service through scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly interfaces.
- Drive innovation in network, security, and infrastructure programmability to accelerate platform adoption. Expand ecosystem partnerships and developer engagement to grow platform consumption and revenue.

Critical Leadership Competencies

Visionary Platform Builder:   Creates and delivers 0-to-1 platform capabilities in Layer 7, security, and application security, inspiring teams to pursue bold technical visions that drive strategic business value.

Architectural Excellence & Technical Leadership: Establishes enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, and standards while teaching and scaling architectural capability across leaders, teams, and domains.

Systems Thinker with Deep Technical Judgment :  Anticipates complex dependencies, failure modes, and security risks to design resilient, scalable, and secure software services.

Transformational Enterprise Leader:  Leads large-scale technology and organizational change, aligning strategy, people, processes, and platforms to deliver measurable business outcomes .

Enterprise Influencer & Global Collaborator: Builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security organizations, leading effectively through influence in highly matrixed, global environments.

Talent Multiplier & Innovation Catalyst:   Develops exceptional technical leaders, fosters a culture of experimentation and continuous learning, and creates the conditions for innovation to thrive at scale .

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
- 15+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership roles at both startups and mid to large complex enterprise app companies Proven record of launching and building early security app or security platform-like products.
- Networking domain knowledge essential as is the ability to lead a team of network architects

- Strategic thinker with a customer-centric mindset, passion for innovation, entrepreneurial drive and the ability to navigate ambiguity.
- Deep understanding of emerging technologies, and product development.
- Deep expertise in modern software engineering practices across DevSecOps, NetOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud-native architecture, and agile methodologies.
- Experience driving architectural standardization across a federated or product-aligned technology organization.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Security Operations (SecOps)
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Product Manager, SecOps to lead the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of security capabilities embedded directly into our engineering ecosystem. This is not a policy-writing or governance role. It is a product role focused on making security scalable, automated, developer-friendly, and measurable.

Security Operations depends on tight coordination between the teams that build and manage security capabilities and the teams that use those capabilities to detect and respond to threats. This Product Manager role creates   a single product   owner for that boundary, ensuring detections, automation, telemetry onboarding, and platform changes are production-ready, governed, measurable, and adopted by analysts and responders.

Responsibilities
Role ownership

- End-to-end detection lifecycle:   Drive the process from threat-informed idea generation through rule development, testing, deployment, tuning, analyst adoption, and retirement.

- SecOps backlog prioritization:   Maintain   and prioritize a shared roadmap across telemetry onboarding, detection content, SOAR playbooks, analyst workflows, and platform enhancements.

- Operational readiness:   Ensure new capabilities launch with runbooks, ownership, success criteria, training, support processes, documentation, and release criteria.

- Cross-team process improvement:   Identify   and reduce friction in handoffs between engineering and operations, resolving delivery blockers and unclear ownership.

- Platform value realization:   Translate security platform capabilities into measurable outcomes, including improved alert quality, faster response, broader telemetry coverage, and higher automation effectiveness.

- Stakeholder alignment:   Create clear decision-making forums and communication rhythms across security engineering,   monitoring   and response, incident management, and threat intelligence.

Key areas of focus

- Detection and rule lifecycle:   Own the product process for how detections move from concept to value, including intake, prioritization, test standards, analyst validation, tuning, coverage review, readiness criteria, handoff quality, false-positive trends, alert fidelity, and lifecycle decisions.

- Telemetry and log onboarding strategy:   Prioritize log sources, parser improvements, and schema normalization based on risk, coverage gaps, investigative value, analyst needs, concrete use cases, dependencies, sequencing, and effort tradeoffs.

- SOAR and automation governance:   Scale automation safely by improving how ideas are   submitted , reviewed, built, tested, approved, and adopted; clarify ownership, controls, approvals, adoption measures, success rates, analyst time savings, and failure patterns.

- Platform roadmap and feature adoption:   Partner with technical leaders to shape adoption of SIEM, SOAR, and AI-assisted operational capabilities, including rollout plans, operational testing, enablement, success metrics, detection-as-code, composite detections, and standardized content management.

- Metrics, reporting, and operating cadence:   Define KPIs, health dashboards, and recurring reviews for detection quality, onboarding throughput, automation effectiveness, operational readiness, roadmap priorities, launch readiness, and post-launch performance.

What   you'll   do

- Own and   maintain   the SecOps product roadmap across shared engineering and operations priorities.

- Partner with leaders in detection engineering,   monitoring   and response, incident management, and threat intelligence to define quarterly   objectives .

- Facilitate prioritization decisions for detections, log sources, automations, integrations, and workflow improvements.

- Define launch criteria for new security content and capabilities, including documentation, training, support model, and success measures.

- Run structured intake and triage for stakeholder requests and convert them into a clear, ranked backlog.

- Lead cross-functional reviews to resolve delivery blockers, unclear ownership, and handoff gaps.

- Develop metrics that show whether new capabilities are improving response speed, alert quality, coverage, and analyst efficiency.

- Document requirements, business value, user workflows, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.

- Represent operational needs in platform discussions and represent engineering realities in operational planning.

- Drive continuous improvement based on analyst feedback, incident learnings, and evolving threat priorities.

Qualifications
- Must-have qualifications

- Experience as a Product Manager owning cross-functional delivery in a complex technical environment.

- Strong understanding of Security Operations concepts, including SIEM, detection engineering, incident response, case management, and security automation.

- Experience prioritizing roadmaps and backlogs across multiple stakeholder groups with competing demands.

- Ability to translate technical platform work into clear user value, measurable outcomes, and release criteria.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with engineers, analysts, managers, and executives.

- Experience building processes, KPIs, and operating cadences in environments where teams depend on one another for outcomes.

- Comfort working with ambiguity and turning loosely defined needs into clear plans and decisions. ​

Preferred qualifications

- Experience supporting or partnering closely with Security Operations Center, incident response, or threat detection teams.

- Familiarity with security telemetry pipelines, data normalization, and log onboarding workflows.

- Experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms such as Google SecOps, Chronicle, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto XSIAM, or similar technologies.

- Exposure to detection engineering practices such as rule testing, content lifecycle management, and detection-as-code.

- Understanding of   response automation design, control frameworks, and approval models for high-impact actions.

- Experience using data to evaluate false positives, alert quality, operational throughput, and workflow adoption.

- Knowledge of common security frameworks and operating models such as NIST incident response guidance.

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Director, Product Software Architecture and Engineering to build and lead a new dev-ops team offering an AI and container management service for Equinix Managed Solutions. Duties include: Partner with product management to define requirements, service level objectives, and operational goals for the service; Integrate the service with global ordering and back-office systems to provide self-service; Work closely with EMS operations, EMS fulfillment, and Equinix network architecture to ensure the service design is compatible and well-integrated with existing infrastructure; Operate the service at an enterprise availability level as it scales out.

Responsibilities

Service Strategy & Platform Leadership
- Define and execute the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Equinix's AI and Container Management Service.
- Partner with Product Management to translate customer needs and market opportunities into platform capabilities.
- Establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs), operational standards, and platform governance.
- Drive adoption of cloud-native best practices across engineering and operations teams.

Architecture & Engineering
- Lead architecture and design decisions and DevOps processes for Kubernetes/OpenShift-based managed services.
- Ensure platform scalability, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
- Drive automation across provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
- Partner with network, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure seamless integration with Equinix's global platform.

System Optimization
- Drives and manages change across the organization by implementing improvements to internal processes and systems
- Proactively identifies gaps, risks and issues and influence key stakeholders across the organization to resolve them

Stakeholder Management
- Responsible for providing objective and comprehensive input to senior leadership and executive decision makers
- Solicits stakeholder input to define comprehensive improvement plans that are consistent and drive standardization across regions
- Influences and collaborates with multiple stakeholders of multiple portfolios and projects to ensure effective release, change management and support plans are defined and communicated
- Creates and drives broad stakeholder communications with respect to portfolio status and budget utilization

System Optimization
- Develop operational KPIs and continuously improve service availability, performance, and customer experience.
- Is accountable for successful implementation of approved system improvement recommendations
- Drives adoption of best practices and standards

People Management
- Build and lead a high-performing global engineering and DevOps organization.
- Responsible for succession planning recommendations and contributing to and driving the people development strategy
- Responsible for talent development, including quarterly conversations, career pathways conversations and individual development/growth plans
- Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications
- Director-level experience managing managers, delivering multiple software products or services
- Proven experience leading DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering teams.
- Strong and demonstrable operational experience providing a highly available global service
- Experience delivering Kubernetes or (preferred) OpenShift-based infrastructure and operating it at scale
- 15+ years professional experience in a software development leadership role
- Bachelor's in Engineering preferred
